improvements: Corrected the roof envelope to the mapped 18 m height.
Replaced an entirely green roof with a grey roof plus independently measured landscaped patches.

The Calea Floreasca front carries the mall's mapped tenants: a black tenant band (Douglas, Hervis, Zara, C&A, H&M) at the north end with Starbucks under it, the glazed entrance hall south of it, then the PROMENADA name with its colour bars.
remainingGaps: Roof garden boundaries are independent aerial measurements with approximately 2 m uncertainty.
Facade grid, entrances and garden surface heights of 18.025/18.05 m are rendering estimates.
Neighbour overlap, terrain support and tourist-scene context need the separate district/scene pass; isolated model pictures do not establish complete parity.
Tenants are the OSM shop nodes; their order and positions along the wall, the band and letter sizes and the entrance hall width are estimated to a few metres from the street look (viewed only).

checks.label: Model studies recaptured at 346f798
checks.details: Front, top and oblique studies recaptured from the unmodified worktree after the district fidelity pass. The front study now stands 75 m in front of the north end of the Calea Floreasca front (tx=-67, tz=-32) so the tenant band is legible; the earlier front study framed the whole 200 m wall from further away. The oblique study still shows the whole building. Headless Chromium (Playwright), ANGLE Direct3D 11 on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 (hardware GL, audio muted). Earlier collections in this record were rendered with SwiftShader, so small shading and anti-aliasing differences are not scene changes.
